newsitem.title: UK: Slough Estates says council withdraws case.
newsitem.headline: Slough Estates says council withdraws case.

text.p: UK real estate company Slough Estates said on Monday that the Welwyn Hatfield District Council, a UK local authority, had decided to withdraw its appeal against a judgement which awarded Slough 49 million stg for fraudulent misrepresentation by the council.
The court action related to changes made to a tenant mix agreement for the Gallerias retail development above the A1 road at Hatfield, north of London.

In July, a court ruled that property development group Slough would not have proceeded with construction of its shopping centre at nearby Welwyn Garden City if it had been aware of the changes made by the council.
It awarded 48 million stg against the council.
Slough said it would soon hold discussions with the council regarding payment of the balance of judgement debt, 10 million stg of which has already been paid.
